description: This file defines the UploadCommandOutputController class, which extends UploadAttachmentController and handles uploading command output files, associating them with commands and command usages, and optionally enqueueing tasks in Redis.

classes.name: UploadCommandOutputController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the upload of command output files, associating them with commands and command usages, and enqueueing tasks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies necessary for handling attachment uploads, file path generation, Redis operations, and repositories for commands and command usages.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request to upload a command output file, saves the attachment, retrieves command info, optionally enqueues a task in Redis, and returns success status.
